intentAndPurpose.intent: `Field.Root` + **RadioGroup** with optional `Field.Label` / `Field.Description`, `infoIconSlot`, `error` / `feedback`, and native `Field.Error` slot — same shell as **InputField** / **CheckboxField**. Integrated single mode has no `Radio` children; colour follows **`appearance`** on inner radios.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role for all children.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Optional description id(s) for the radiogroup (e.g. field description).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: When there is no string `label`, sets the radiogroup accessible name.

props.name: checked
props.description: Integrated single mode only — controlled on/off (`true` = selected `singleOptionValue`). Prefer `value` / `onValueChange` when you need the string value directly.

props.name: children
props.description: `Radio` options. Omit for integrated single-option field (label + implicit control).

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Integrated single mode only — uncontrolled default on/off. When set, overrides `defaultValue` for the implicit lone option unless `value` is controlled.

props.name: infoIconSlot
props.description: Trailing control beside the label (custom info trigger or `InputFieldDefaultInfo`).

props.name: omitLayoutWrapper
props.description: When true, the group root does not apply the default flex layout (use with `display: contents` class for grid embedding).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Integrated single mode — fired when the lone option toggles (in addition to `onValueChange`).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the group is read-only (focusable but value cannot change)

props.name: required
props.description: When true with a string `label`, shows the required asterisk in the label row.

props.name: singleOptionValue
props.description: Form value for the implicit lone **Radio** when `children` is omitted (default `'on'`). Group is “on” when `value === singleOptionValue`, “off” when `value === ''`.

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset for all children. Default: 'm'

interactionBehavior.summary: RadioField is a Field.Root wrapper, not a control: hover, press, tap-scale, and the informative-blue focus halo all belong to the inner Radio. Two things the wrapper uniquely owns. First, INTEGRATED SINGLE (no Radio children) can toggle OFF — re-clicking the selected circle clears the value to `''` via a click-capture handler, which a normal radio cannot do. Second, that circle uses `labelWrapper="div"`, so the field `Field.Label` is a real `<label>` associated through Base UI `htmlFor`; the field description is `aria-describedby` only and is not inside that label. Multi-option mode is a fieldset+legend above a normal RadioGroup that still arrows-to-select.
hover: RadioField.module.css has no `:hover` rule. Hover chrome is the inner Radio's: the 16–24px circle tints, wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)`.
Unchecked hover fills the circle with the parent-surface role's `--{Role}-Hover` (Neutral on a bare page), not the field's `appearance`. Checked hover steps fill and border to `--{Role}-Bold-Hover`.
There is no hover styling on the field label or description.
press: The inner Radio circle scales UP on press (`--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up`, 7%) and tints to `--{Role}-Pressed` (unchecked) or `--{Role}-Bold-Pressed` (checked).
In integrated single, a press on an ALREADY-SELECTED circle is intercepted in capture and clears the value instead of being a no-op — that is the whole point of the wrapper's `onClickCapture`.
focus: Focus lands on the inner `role="radio"` span, never on the Field.Label. The halo is Radio's two-layer ring whose OUTER colour is `--Informative-Bold`, not `--Focus-Outline` — a `positive` or `negative` option still focuses informative-blue.
`:focus-visible` only on the circle; clicking the field label activates the control but does not paint the ring (mouse click).

`readOnly` radios stay focusable (Base UI `readOnly`, not `disabled`). RadioField then strips `aria-readonly` from `[role="radio"]` because that attribute is invalid there; `data-readonly` styling remains.
keyboard: RadioField adds no key handlers. Keyboard is the inner RadioGroup: `Space` selects, `Enter` is deliberately swallowed, arrow keys move AND select, `Home` / `End` do nothing (`enableHomeAndEndKeys: false` on RadioGroup).

In multi-option mode the field `Field.Label` lives in a `<legend>` and does not itself select an option; each child Radio uses the default native `<label>` wrapper, so that option's own label/description text is the hit target.

In integrated single the Radio is `labelWrapper="div"` with `children={null}`. The visible name is `aria-labelledby` pointing at a span inside `Field.Label`, and Base UI's `htmlFor` also associates that `<label>` with the radio's hidden input, so clicking the field label text activates the control.
The field description is a `Field.Description` sibling (`aria-describedby` on the group) — it is not a `<label>` and is not a toggle hit target.
The capture-to-clear path is a mouse `onClickCapture` on the radio wrapper. Whether a keyboard Space on an already-selected integrated radio also clears is not covered by tests.
selected: Multi-option selection is owned by the inner RadioGroup via `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`. Selecting one option deselects the others; you cannot empty the group by re-clicking the selected option.

Integrated single (no children) is the exception: re-clicking the selected circle fires `onValueChange('')` and `onCheckedChange(false)` and sets `aria-checked="false"` — covered by a unit test. A second click selects again (`singleOptionValue`, default `'on'`).

Integrated single can be driven as a boolean (`checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onCheckedChange`) or as a string (`value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`); when neither is controlled, the wrapper holds internal state so the clear-to-empty path can actually stick (Base UI will not fire change on re-clicking a selected radio by itself).
Checked fill/dot colours are Radio's: `--{Role}-Bold` circle, `--{Role}-Bold-TintedA11y` dot. `appearance` on the field is forwarded onto every option.
disabled: `disabled` is passed to `Field.Root`, the RadioGroup, and every enhanced child Radio, and `data-disabled` is set on the label stack so the label/description drop to `--Text-Low`.

The inner Radio's `not-allowed` cursor IS observable: the circle is `pointer-events: none`, so the pointer falls through to Radio's `<label>`/`<div>` wrapper, which also declares `not-allowed` (see the Radio docs). In integrated single that wrapper is a `<div>`, but it still carries the cursor.

`readOnly` forwards to each Radio for interaction lock and `data-readonly` ink, and RadioField strips the invalid `aria-readonly` from the `role="radio"` node. The capture-to-clear handler also no-ops when `disabled` or `readOnly`.
touch: Hover tints never apply on touch-only devices; the inner Radio's +7% press scale plus the pressed tint are the response to a tap on the circle.

In integrated single the field `Field.Label` extends the hit target across the label text, but the description row is not part of that label. In multi-option mode each option's own Radio `<label>` (label + that option's description) is the hit target — the fieldset legend is not.
Nothing pads the row to 44px; the circle itself is 16/20/24px at S/M/L.
